title: Xray-core configuration
description: Xray-core v26.10.31 JSON config (from infra/conf). Keys are matched case-insensitively by the core.

outbounds.description: Outbounds; the first one is the default route.

transport.description: Removed: global transport config is rejected; use streamSettings in each inbound/outbound.

fakedns.description: Same as fakeDns (the documented spelling; keys are case-insensitive).

env.description: Environment variables set before the config is built.

tag.description: Outbound tag of the API; route an inbound to it to expose the gRPC API.

listen.description: Listen address for the API directly (no routing needed).

tag.description: Balancer tag, referenced by rules' balancerTag.

selector.description: Outbound tag prefixes to balance over.

fallbackTag.description: Outbound used when no selected outbound is healthy.

type.description: Strategy (case-insensitive). leastPing needs observatory; leastLoad needs burstObservatory.

connectivity.description: URL used to check local connectivity; empty skips the check.

ocspStapling.description: OCSP stapling refresh interval in seconds (0 = off).

oneTimeLoading.description: Load files only once (no hot reload).

buildChain.description: Build the full chain when issuing (usage issue).

servers.description: DNS servers, queried in order with domain-based preference.

hosts.description: Static hosts: keys are domains (domain rule syntax, e.g. "domain:", "geosite:").

additionalProperties.description: IP, list of IPs, or a domain to redirect to.

tag.description: Inbound tag given to DNS queries for routing.

serveStale.description: Serve expired cache entries while refreshing.

serveExpiredTTL.description: Max seconds an expired entry may be served.

disableFallback.description: Do not fall back to other servers.

disableFallbackIfMatch.description: Do not fall back when a server's domains matched.

useSystemHosts.description: Also load the OS hosts file.

script.description: DNS script (cannot be combined with fallback options).

DnsServer.description: A DNS server: an address string, or an object with per-server options.

address.description: Server address: IP, "localhost", "fakedns", or a URL (tcp://, tcp+local://, https://, https+local://, h2c://, quic+local://).

domains.description: Domains this server is preferred for (domain rule syntax).

expectedIPs.description: Only accept answers in these IPs/CIDRs/geoip; "*" keeps others as fallback.

unexpectedIPs.description: Reject answers in these IPs/CIDRs/geoip; "*" keeps them as fallback.

skipFallback.description: Do not use this server in fallback queries.

finalQuery.description: Stop after querying this server, even on failure.

clientIp.description: EDNS Client Subnet IP sent to this server.

tag.description: Tag for routing this server's queries.

serveStale.description: Serve expired cache entries while refreshing.

serveExpiredTTL.description: Max seconds an expired entry may be served.

id.description: Identifier of this server (used by DNS scripts).

DokodemoSettings.description: Dokodemo-door / tunnel inbound settings (Marzban's API_INBOUND uses this).

address.description: Forward to this address (classic name; same as rewriteAddress).

port.description: Forward to this port (classic name; same as rewritePort).

network.description: Accepted networks (classic name; same as allowedNetwork).

portMap.description: Map of local port to "host:port" targets.

DomainStrategy.description: How domain targets are resolved before dialing: AsIs keeps the domain, UseIP* resolves with fallback to the domain, ForceIP* fails if resolution fails. Case-insensitive.

FakeDns.description: FakeDNS pool, or an array of pools (IPv4 and IPv6).

ipPool.description: CIDR from which fake IPs are allocated.
CIDR from which fake IPs are allocated.

Fallback.description: Fallback target for traffic that fails protocol authentication.

name.description: Match on the TLS SNI; empty matches any.

alpn.description: Match on the negotiated TLS ALPN; empty matches any.

path.description: Match on the HTTP path of the first packet; must be empty or start with "/".

type.description: Destination type; inferred from dest when empty ("tcp", "unix", or "serve" for serve-ws-none).

dest.description: Where to forward unmatched traffic: a port, "addr:port", a Unix socket path ("@abstract" too) or "serve-ws-none".

xver.description: Send a PROXY protocol header of this version (0 = off).

FinalMask.description: Final masks (fragment, noise, obfuscation) applied to the raw connection.

tcp.description: TCP mask layers, applied in order.

udp.description: UDP mask layers, applied in order.

Fingerprint.description: uTLS ClientHello fingerprint to imitate (case-insensitive). Empty means chrome; "unsafe" disables uTLS; "random"/"randomized" pick one at startup.

targetStrategy.description: Resolve domains before connecting (migrated to sockopt.domainStrategy).

redirect.description: Send all traffic to this "host:port" (either part may be empty).

proxyProtocol.description: Send a PROXY protocol header (0 = off).

finalRules.description: Final allow/block rules on the resolved destination.

blockDelay.description: Delay before closing blocked connections, seconds.

packet.description: Packet content or length range for rand.

cron.description: Cron expression for automatic geodata updates.

outbound.description: Outbound tag used to download geodata.

file.description: Local file name to save it as.

GrpcSettings.description: gRPC transport (deprecated by upstream in favour of XHTTP).

idle_timeout.description: Seconds without data before a health check (client).

permit_without_stream.description: Allow health checks without active streams (client).

initial_windows_size.description: Initial HTTP/2 window size (0 = gRPC default).

path.description: Request paths (one is picked at random).

headers.description: Headers; array values are picked at random.
Headers; array values are picked at random.

allowTransparent.description: Forward all HTTP requests, not only proxy requests.

email.description: User email, used in stats and logs.

servers.description: Legacy form with exactly one server; prefer the flat fields.

email.description: User email, used in stats and logs.

HttpUpgradeSettings.description: HTTPUpgrade transport (deprecated by upstream in favour of XHTTP).

headers.description: Extra HTTP headers (must not contain Host).

acceptProxyProtocol.description: Accept a PROXY protocol header (inbound only).

clients.description: Managed by the panel; leave empty.

email.description: User email, used in stats and logs.

users.description: Alias of clients. Managed by the panel; leave empty.

email.description: User email, used in stats and logs.

HysteriaOutboundSettings.description: Hysteria 2 outbound settings (auth goes in streamSettings.hysteriaSettings).

udpIdleTimeout.description: UDP session idle timeout in seconds (2-600).

tag.description: Inbound tag, used by routing. In Marzban the tag names the inbound for users/hosts; "API_INBOUND" is the panel's API inbound.

listen.description: Listen address or Unix socket path ("@name" for abstract).

port.description: Listen port(s); not needed for Unix sockets or tun.

header.description: Ignored by this version; use streamSettings.finalmask.udp with type "mkcp-legacy".

seed.description: Ignored by this version; use finalmask "mkcp-legacy" value.

regexp.description: Treat match as a regular expression.

baselines.description: RTT baselines used to group outbounds.

maxRTT.description: Outbounds slower than this are ignored.

uplinkOnly.description: Seconds to keep the connection after the downlink closes.

downlinkOnly.description: Seconds to keep the connection after the uplink closes.

bufferSize.description: Per-connection buffer size in KB; negative means unlimited, 0 disables buffering.

afterBytes.description: Start limiting after this many bytes.

bytesPerSec.description: Rate limit in bytes per second (0 = off).

burstBytesPerSec.description: Burst allowance in bytes per second.

access.description: Access log file path; empty logs to stdout, "none" disables it.

error.description: Error log file path; empty logs to stdout, "none" disables it.

loglevel.description: Error log level; anything unrecognised means "warning". "none" disables both logs.

maskAddress.description: Mask IPs in logs: "quarter", "half", "full" or custom "/v4bits+/v6bits".

inboundTag.description: Inbound tag the traffic re-enters routing with.

clients.description: Managed by the panel; leave empty.

email.description: User email (required, unique).

users.description: Alias of clients. Managed by the panel; leave empty.

email.description: User email (required, unique).

address.description: Tunnel prefixes (at most one IPv4 and one IPv6).

remoteDNS.description: DNS servers used inside the tunnel.

MasqueSettings.description: MASQUE transport (only with the masque protocol).

host.description: HTTP authority (defaults to the WARP host when warp is set).

privateKey.description: ECDSA P-256 private key (PEM or base64 DER).

publicKey.description: Peer PKIX public key (PEM or base64 DER).

address.description: Assigned addresses (one IPv4 and/or one IPv6).

Metrics.description: Metrics (expvar/pprof) endpoint; needs a tag or listen.

tag.description: Outbound tag for metrics (route an inbound to it).

listen.description: Listen address serving /debug/vars and pprof directly.

concurrency.description: Max TCP streams per connection (negative disables TCP mux).

xudpProxyUDP443.description: How to handle UDP/443 (QUIC) with mux.

NetworkList.description: Networks: "tcp", "udp" ("unix" also parses); an array or a comma-separated string such as "tcp,udp".

sendThrough.description: Local IP (or CIDR for random IPs) to send from; "origin"/"srcip" use the inbound's local IP.

targetStrategy.description: Resolve the target domain before sending (for freedom it moves to sockopt.domainStrategy).

proxySettings.description: Removed: the core rejects it; use streamSettings.sockopt.dialerProxy.

levels.description: Policies keyed by user level (as a string, e.g. "0").

statsInboundUplink.description: Count uplink traffic of all tagged inbounds.

statsInboundDownlink.description: Count downlink traffic of all tagged inbounds.

statsOutboundUplink.description: Count uplink traffic of all tagged outbounds.

statsOutboundDownlink.description: Count downlink traffic of all tagged outbounds.

PortList.description: A port, a range "from-to", or a comma-separated list of both ("env:VAR" reads an environment variable).

QueryStrategy.description: Which record types to query: UseIP (A+AAAA), UseIPv4, UseIPv6, UseSystem. Case-insensitive; also accepts use_ip/use-ip style aliases. Unknown values mean UseIP.

disableChromeParrot.description: Do not imitate Chrome's QUIC parameters.

acceptProxyProtocol.description: Accept a PROXY protocol header (inbound only).

RealitySettings.description: REALITY settings (RAW, XHTTP or gRPC only).

target.description: Server: where non-REALITY traffic is forwarded ("host:port", port, or Unix socket).

type.description: Target network type; inferred from target when empty.

xver.description: PROXY protocol version sent to target (0 = off).

privateKey.description: Server: X25519 private key (base64url, from "xray x25519").

shortIds.description: Server: allowed short IDs (hex, up to 16 chars; "" allowed).

maxTimeDiff.description: Server: max allowed clock difference in ms (0 = off).

mldsa65Seed.description: Server: ML-DSA-65 seed for post-quantum signatures.

masterKeyLog.description: Write TLS master keys to this file (debugging).

fingerprint.description: Client: uTLS fingerprint (required; "unsafe" and "hellogolang" are rejected).

serverName.description: Client: SNI to send (one of the server's serverNames).

mldsa65Verify.description: Client: ML-DSA-65 public key for verification.

spiderX.description: Client: initial crawler path and parameters.

Reverse.description: Legacy reverse proxy: removed, the core rejects it. Use VLESS reverse instead.

domain.description: Domain used for the reverse connection.
Domain used for the reverse connection.

domainStrategy.description: Domain resolution for IP rules (case-insensitive): AsIs, IPIfNonMatch (resolve if no rule matched), IPOnDemand (resolve on first IP rule).

rules.description: Rules, evaluated top to bottom; the first match wins.

script.description: Routing script; cannot be combined with rules or domainStrategy.

RoutingRule.description: A routing rule; all specified conditions must match.

type.description: Legacy rule type; not read by the core (all rules are field rules).

ruleTag.description: Name of the rule, shown in logs.

outboundTag.description: Outbound to use when the rule matches (this or balancerTag is required).

balancerTag.description: Balancer to use when the rule matches.

ip.description: Destination IP matchers: IP, CIDR, "geoip:", "ext:file:tag"; prefix "!" to negate geoip.

sourceIP.description: Source IP matchers (same syntax as ip).

vlessRoute.description: VLESS route value(s) (from the UUID's 7th-8th bytes) to match.

attrs.description: HTTP header attributes to match (sniffed HTTP only), e.g. {":method": "GET"}.

webhook.description: Send a webhook when the rule matches.

url.description: URL to notify when the rule matches.

method.description: Cipher (legacy single-cipher users); must be empty for Shadowsocks 2022 users.

email.description: User email, used in stats and logs.

method.description: Cipher. 2022-blake3-* select Shadowsocks 2022 (multi-user only with aes); *-ietf-* and aead_* are aliases.

password.description: Password, or server key for Shadowsocks 2022 (base64, "openssl rand -base64 16|32").

clients.description: Managed by the panel; leave empty.

users.description: Alias of clients. Managed by the panel; leave empty.

email.description: User email, used in stats and logs.

email.description: User email, used in stats and logs.

destOverride.description: Protocols whose sniffed domain overrides the destination. "https"/"ssl" are aliases of "tls" (prefer "tls"); "fakedns+others" equals "fakedns".

domainsExcluded.description: Domains never overridden by sniffing (domain rule syntax).

ipsExcluded.description: Destination IPs/CIDRs (or geoip:) for which sniffing results are ignored.

metadataOnly.description: Only use connection metadata (e.g. fakedns); do not read payload.

routeOnly.description: Use the sniffed domain only for routing; keep the original destination address.

tcpFastOpen.description: TCP Fast Open: true/false, or a queue length (server) / positive number.

tproxy.description: Transparent proxy mode (Linux inbounds); other values mean off.

dialerProxy.description: Outbound tag to dial through (proxy chaining).

tcpKeepAliveInterval.description: TCP keep-alive interval in seconds (negative disables).

tcpKeepAliveIdle.description: TCP keep-alive idle time in seconds.

penetrate.description: Pass sockopt to the dialerProxy's connection.

v6only.description: Listen on IPv6 only when listening on ::.

addressPortStrategy.description: Look up target address/port from SRV/TXT records (case-insensitive).

tryDelayMs.description: Delay before the next attempt in ms.

interleave.description: Addresses of one family before switching.

trustedXForwardedFor.description: Headers trusted for the client IP (e.g. behind a CDN).

Stats.description: Enables traffic statistics (empty object; counters are enabled through policy).

network.description: Transport. Aliases: raw=tcp (prefer raw), xhttp=splithttp (prefer xhttp), kcp=mkcp, ws=websocket. Removed: h2/http/quic.

method.description: Alias of network; takes precedence when set.

address.description: Dial this address instead of the proxy server's (mainly in xhttp downloadSettings).

port.description: Dial this port instead of the proxy server's (mainly in xhttp downloadSettings).

packets.description: Which packets to fragment: "tlshello" or a range like "1-3".

serverName.description: SNI to send (client) / expected server name.

curvePreferences.description: Key-exchange curves in preference order (case-insensitive; unknown names are ignored with a warning).

rejectUnknownSni.description: Reject handshakes whose SNI matches no certificate (server).

disableSystemRoot.description: Do not trust system root CAs.

useSystemCA.description: Verify with the OS certificate store.

pinnedPeerCertSha256.description: Comma-separated SHA-256 hashes (hex) of trusted peer certificates.

verifyPeerCertByName.description: Comma-separated names to verify the peer certificate against instead of serverName.

masterKeyLog.description: Write TLS master keys to this file (debugging).

echConfigList.description: ECH config list, or a DNS query spec to fetch it (client).

echSockopt.description: Socket options for fetching the ECH config.

allowInsecure.description: Removed: the core rejects it; use pinnedPeerCertSha256 or verifyPeerCertByName.

XdriveSettings.description: XDRIVE transport (cloud-storage relay; VLESS with encryption only).

service.description: Storage backend ("Google Drive" is a deprecated alias of google-drive).

remoteFolder.description: Remote folder used for the exchange.

secrets.description: Credentials; google-drive needs ClientID, ClientSecret, RefreshToken.

xPaddingBytes.description: Padding size range in bytes (cannot be disabled).

uplinkHTTPMethod.description: HTTP method for uploads (GET only in packet-up).

sessionIDPlacement.description: Where the session ID is placed.

sessionIDKey.description: Session ID key when not in path.

sessionIDTable.description: Character table (or preset name) for generated session IDs.

seqPlacement.description: Where the sequence number is placed.

seqKey.description: Sequence key when not in path.

uplinkDataPlacement.description: Where upload data is placed (cookie/header only in packet-up).

uplinkDataKey.description: Upload data key when not in body.

noGRPCHeader.description: Do not send the gRPC content-type header (stream-up/one).

noSSEHeader.description: Do not send the SSE content-type header (server).

scMinPostsIntervalMs.description: Min interval between upload POSTs in ms (client, packet-up).

scStreamUpServerSecs.description: Server padding interval in seconds for stream-up.

serverMaxHeaderBytes.description: Max request header size on the server (0 = default).

downloadSettings.description: Separate stream settings for the download direction (client; not in stream-one). Use address/port to dial another server.

extra.description: Extra settings (all fields except host/path/mode); when present it replaces the outer fields.

maxConcurrency.description: Max streams per connection (mutually exclusive with maxConnections).

maxConnections.description: Max connections to open (mutually exclusive with maxConcurrency).

cMaxReuseTimes.description: Max times a connection is reused.

hKeepAlivePeriod.description: HTTP keep-alive ping period in seconds (negative disables).
